description: EVENS AI OS — 17 core agents; roster provisioning retired

coreAgents.title: Chief of staff
coreAgents.operatorSummary: Set daily priorities across life, business, wealth, and projects; arbitrate ownership conflicts.
coreAgents.partnerOutcome: Attention overload — one ranked focus list instead of 17 competing voices.

coreAgents.title: Daily schedule architect
coreAgents.operatorSummary: Build realistic weekday plans from calendar, deadlines, and project state.
coreAgents.partnerOutcome: Calendar chaos — protected focus blocks and prep time before meetings.

coreAgents.title: Control plane & uptime
coreAgents.operatorSummary: Ingest events, dedupe, run health smokes, route failures, track API cost.
coreAgents.partnerOutcome: Silent breakage — golden paths, smokes, disk, and CI drift surfaced early.

coreAgents.title: Approval gateway
coreAgents.operatorSummary: Surface L3/L4 decisions with standard APPROVE/EDIT/REJECT format and /pro links.
coreAgents.partnerOutcome: Tier 3 queue blindness — money, send, deploy, secrets never auto-execute.

coreAgents.title: Business finance ops
coreAgents.operatorSummary: Track business revenue, expenses, subscriptions, pipeline economics, and runway.
coreAgents.partnerOutcome: Business cash blind spots — MRR, CAC, margins, unpaid invoices.

coreAgents.title: Prospect discovery
coreAgents.operatorSummary: Find, enrich, and rank ICP-matching prospects; draft warm outreach context.
coreAgents.partnerOutcome: Empty pipeline — qualified leads with pain-fit, not spray-and-pray spam.

coreAgents.title: Product owner & launch
coreAgents.operatorSummary: Own positioning, launch readiness, growth experiments, and product-state milestones.
coreAgents.partnerOutcome: Build-without-market-fit — validates demand before Forge burns cycles.

coreAgents.title: Evidence & OSINT
coreAgents.operatorSummary: Gather cited evidence; label FACT/INFERENCE/OPINION/UNVERIFIED; report uncertainty.
coreAgents.partnerOutcome: Hype-driven decisions — verifiable briefs before money or build commits.

coreAgents.title: Autonomous engineer
coreAgents.operatorSummary: Full dev loop: reproduce → branch → fix → test → PR → CI → staging smoke → handoff.
coreAgents.partnerOutcome: Shipping bottleneck — vertical slices with DONE_WHEN instead of doc-only plans.

coreAgents.title: Visual & media creation
coreAgents.operatorSummary: Design, video concepts, motion, game art, UI specs — creates assets, not distribution.
coreAgents.partnerOutcome: Weak proof artifacts — landing visuals, demos, and brand consistency.

coreAgents.title: Strategic client advisor
coreAgents.operatorSummary: Audits, proposals, ROI memos, discovery — may disagree with Big Boss.
coreAgents.partnerOutcome: Feature-request traps — constraint-first scope with four-blank footer.

coreAgents.title: Memory & chronicle
coreAgents.operatorSummary: Capture decisions, goals, lessons, scoreboard; maintain OPERATOR_MEMORY with provenance.
coreAgents.partnerOutcome: Institutional amnesia — searchable memory without receipt-level noise.

coreAgents.title: Portfolio intelligence
coreAgents.operatorSummary: Portfolio review, thesis tracking, benchmark vs S&P, opportunity research.
coreAgents.partnerOutcome: Reactive investing — evidence-based watchlists without autonomous trades.

coreAgents.title: Personal finance strategy
coreAgents.operatorSummary: Savings rate, runway, major purchases, housing, debt, wealth trajectory planning.
coreAgents.partnerOutcome: Personal cash confusion — strategy layer above Money Desk business ops.

coreAgents.title: Work & compensation
coreAgents.operatorSummary: Comp analysis, accomplishment tracking, negotiation prep, exit-to-entrepreneurship planning.
coreAgents.partnerOutcome: Under-leveraged career — documented wins and market comps before asks.

coreAgents.title: Email triage & drafts
coreAgents.operatorSummary: Classify inbox, label/archive noise, summarize important threads, draft replies.
coreAgents.partnerOutcome: Inbox attention tax — relationship-aware triage without unrestricted sending.

coreAgents.title: Content distribution
coreAgents.operatorSummary: Repurpose, metadata, scheduling, platform formatting, analytics ingestion (Studio creates).
coreAgents.partnerOutcome: Creation-without-distribution — multi-platform publish pipeline with HITL preview.
